description: cluster-plex: Plex playback and transcodes, the GPU and remux pools, the proxy, libraries and clustarr's projection, provisioning and Live TV. Every series is clusterplex_*, filtered by namespace and pod.

panels.title: Serving pods
panels.description: Plex pods answering for the library. A pod withdraws while it is not ready to serve.

panels.title: plex.tv lease
panels.description: 1 while some pod holds the plex.tv lease: it publishes the server and runs the singleton work.

panels.title: Playing now
panels.description: Items Plex is playing to clients.

panels.title: Lagging transcodes
panels.description: Transcodes slower than real time: a player is waiting on them.

panels.title: clustarr watch
panels.description: 1 once the lease holder's watch of clustarr's MediaFiles has synced.

panels.title: Libraries off their agent
panels.description: Libraries on another agent than their configured provider.

panels.title: Helper jobs running
panels.description: Plex helper processes (scanner, transcoder) running now.

panels.title: Plays
panels.description: Finished plays over the dashboard's range.

panels.title: Watch time
panels.description: Time spent playing over the dashboard's range, paused time excluded.

panels.title: Now playing
panels.description: Playbacks Plex is serving now, from /status/sessions.

targets.expr: sum by (user, player, platform, media_type, decision, location, resolution, state) (clusterplex_plex_streams{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Streams by location
panels.description: lan or wan, as Plex classifies each player's address.

panels.title: Bandwidth by user
panels.description: Bandwidth Plex budgets for each playback.

panels.title: Plays by user
panels.description: Over the dashboard's range.

panels.title: Transcodes by video and hardware
panels.description: Transcode sessions by video decision and hardware decoder and encoder (none is software).

panels.title: Transcodes by node
panels.description: Where each transcode ran: a GPU pool pod's node for a conversion sent there.

panels.title: Lagging and throttled
panels.description: Lagging: slower than real time, the player waits. Throttled: far enough ahead that Plex paused it.

panels.title: Helper invocations
panels.description: Plex helper invocations the shim intercepted, by binary and where it ran.

panels.title: Pool conversions running
panels.description: Conversions each pool pod runs (the GPU pool's and the CPU pool's), by output.

panels.title: Conversion refusals
panels.description: Video conversions refused rather than run on the GPU pool.

panels.title: Conversion startup overhead (p90)
panels.description: A conversion's first segment's arrival less the input time it covers.

panels.title: Pool encode speed (p50)
panels.description: A finished conversion's media seconds per second it ran. Below 1 is slower than real time.

panels.title: Conversions by pool
panels.description: Video conversions started, by the pool that took them (gpu, cpu): the CPU route (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-cpu-video-route-design.md) sends them to the CPU pool while clustarr holds work for the Intel GPU.

panels.title: Pools passed over
panels.description: A pool passed over for a conversion, by pool and reason: full (every ready pod's slots taken) or ineligible (the pod judged the source beyond its rule); the other pool took it or the job was refused.

panels.title: Library items
panels.description: Items in each library section by type, reported by the lease holder.

panels.title: Refreshes and scans sent for clustarr
panels.description: Plex refreshes and scans sent because clustarr changed an item or a file.

panels.title: Files seeded
panels.description: Files the seeder wrote clustarr's streams and markers for into Plex.

panels.title: Missing files found
panels.description: Gone files the projection's sweeps found: removed, revived or projected.

panels.title: Media served by the proxy
panels.description: Media bytes the proxy served directly, which Plex cannot see.

panels.title: Requests waiting for Plex
panels.description: Requests that had to wait for a Plex Media Server to become available.

panels.title: Stale Live TV grabs ended
panels.description: Grabs no player watched, ended to free their tuner.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: The cluster-plex processes' own memory (not Plex Media Server's).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used by the cluster-plex processes.

title: Cluster Plex
